terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.section1Text: Welcome to Padmanabha Fabrics ("we", "our", or "us"). By accessing our store, placing a retail enquiry, purchasing fabric yardage, or procuring wholesale textile inventory from our premises in Ambattur, Chennai or through our website, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.
terms.section2Text:
Our textiles encompass handwoven silks, raw silks, brocades, linen, and artisanal cottons. Handloom weaves and traditional zari may feature subtle organic variations in weave tension, texture, and slub yarn. Such characteristics are the hallmark of authentic textile craftsmanship and are not considered manufacturing defects.

While we capture photographs under balanced studio lighting, actual colors may slightly differ based on your device display settings and lighting conditions. For bulk and wholesale dye-lot consistency, we encourage ordering fabric swatches or visiting our Chennai showroom prior to high-volume cuts.
terms.section3Text:
All prices displayed in our online showcase are sample catalog rates and inclusive of applicable GST unless explicitly stated otherwise. We accept secure UPI payments, credit/debit cards, net banking, and Cash on Delivery (COD) for eligible domestic destinations.

Orders are confirmed upon receipt of authorized payment or confirmation of COD address verification by our customer support team.
terms.section4Text: Orders are packaged with protective moisture-barrier wrapping and dispatched directly from our Ambattur, Chennai facility via trusted courier partners. Standard domestic deliveries across India take 2 to 6 business days. Tracking numbers are shared via WhatsApp and email upon dispatch.
terms.section5Text: These terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of India. Any legal dispute or claim arising out of transactions with Padmanabha Fabrics shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.
terms.supportNote: Email us at padmanabhafabrics@gmail.com or call +91 99401 35700

refund.title: Refund & Return Policy
refund.section1Text: At Padmanabha Fabrics, every meter of fabric and woven saree undergoes strict inspection at our Ambattur warehouse before packaging. We take pride in delivering premier handloom and mill textiles that meet authentic standards of yarn, weave, and luster.
refund.section2Text:
Customers may request an exchange or return within 7 days of delivery under the following conditions:
• The item received has a noticeable weaving defect, manufacturing tear, or incorrect fabric dispatch.
• Sarees, unstitched drapes, and apparel must be unworn, unwashed, unaltered, and accompanied by original folds and tags.
• An unboxing photo or video showing the parcel upon receipt assists in rapid verification.
refund.section3Text: In accordance with textile industry practices, running fabric yardage custom-cut to specific customer measurements (e.g., 2.5m, 4m) cannot be returned unless delivered with a genuine physical defect or transit damage, as custom cuts cannot be reattached to the original roll.
refund.section4Text:
To initiate a return:
1. Message our dispatch team on WhatsApp (+91 99401 45700) or email padmanabhafabrics@gmail.com with your Order Number and photos of the issue.
2. Upon approval, we arrange a reverse pickup via our logistics partner or provide the return shipping address in Ambattur, Chennai.
3. Once inspected at our facility, an exchange piece is dispatched immediately or a refund is initiated.
refund.section5Text: Approved refunds are processed within 24 to 48 business hours of inspection. Online payments (UPI, Card, Net Banking) are refunded directly to the original payment source (takes 3 to 5 banking days). Cash on Delivery orders are refunded via direct UPI transfer or NEFT bank transfer as requested by the buyer.
refund.supportNote: WhatsApp our team at +91 99401 45700 or call us anytime.
